info.title: LexiShield API
info.description:
Private legal document triage, fully on-device, powered by Google Gemma via Ollama.

All errors use `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457). Endpoints that return **501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED**
are part of the frozen contract and are delivered in the phase named in the error detail.
Nothing here is legal advice.

schema.title: Response Benchmark Api V1 System Benchmark Get

post.summary: Upload a PDF or TXT (multipart field `file`)

get.description:
Server-Sent Events stream. Each event has `event:` set to one of
`job.stage`, `classification.ready`, `checklist.item`, `card.ready`, `warning`,
`report.ready`, `job.failed`, and a JSON `data:` payload:

| event | data |
|---|---|
| job.stage | JobProgress |
| classification.ready | {classification: Classification, jurisdiction: JurisdictionInfo} |
| checklist.item | ChecklistItem |
| card.ready | ClauseCard |
| warning | IngestionWarning |
| report.ready | {document_id, report_url} |
| job.failed | Problem |
